episode.title: What Economics Can Learn

chapters.title: Intro: How We Read and Why
Chapter 1: Economics, Anthropology, Sociology: The Sad Divergence

episode.tagline: The study of humanity is the study of humanity. Everything is everything. And yet, different disciplines of study have imprisoned themselves in silos, refusing to learn from each other.
episode.about: In this episode, Amit and Ajay discuss a great paper from Biju Rao that talks about what economists can learn from anthropologists and sociologists -- and how only a multidisciplinary approach can reveal the world.
